title: Gitea: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 59 days old, so current versions are being attacked. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: Developer tools
category.why: It holds source code and the keys used to build and ship software.
category.doThis: Patch it. If it faced the internet, change the keys and passwords stored in it.

summary: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Aug 28, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
